SIGN_IN_TITLE: Sign in to the Platform Console
SIGN_IN_DESCRIPTION: Sign in with your Arclayer account, then complete security verification.
CREDENTIALS_DESCRIPTION: Your product app sign-in isn't used here.
SECURITY_KEY_SETUP_DESCRIPTION: Add a security key or passkey before entering the Platform Console.
ADD_SECURITY_KEY_TO_CONTINUE: Add a security key or passkey
USE_SECURITY_KEY_OR_PASSKEY: Use a security key or passkey
AUTHENTICATOR_APP_SETUP_REQUIRED: Set up an authenticator app to protect this account's Platform Console access.
AUTHENTICATOR_SETUP_DESCRIPTION: Add this code to your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
VERIFICATION_CODE_DESCRIPTION: Enter the current code from your authenticator app.
VERIFICATION_CODE_RETRY: Check the current code and try again.
RECOVERY_CODES_DESCRIPTION: Each code works once if you lose access to your authenticator app. They will not be shown again.
RECOVERY_CODES_SAVED_CONFIRMATION: I saved these recovery codes in a secure place.
SIGN_OUT_DESCRIPTION: The Platform Console will end the session on this device, then return you to sign-in.
SIGN_OUT_CONSEQUENCE: This doesn't sign you out of the product app or revoke sessions on other devices.
SIGN_OUT_ERROR: This device was not signed out
SIGN_OUT_UNCHANGED: The service didn't confirm sign-out, so this device is still signed in. Try again or revoke it from another device.
ERROR_TITLE: Can't load access and security information
ERROR_DESCRIPTION: Current access and security status can't be confirmed.
PERMISSION_DESCRIPTION: Ask the Instance Owner or an authorized Platform Operator for access.
EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: There are no records to show.
TEAM_DESCRIPTION: Review the Instance Owner, platform operators, and invitations awaiting a response or no longer valid.
INVITE_OPERATOR_DESCRIPTION: Choose an existing account and the platform roles it gets after the invitation is accepted and security setup is complete.
PERSON_SEARCH_HELP: Search active Arclayer accounts by name, email address, or username.
PERSON_SEARCH_ERROR: People couldn't be loaded. Close this window and try again.
INVITE_ROLES_HELP: When this invitation is accepted, the system checks the roles and access that are current then.
OPERATOR_INVITED: The operator invitation was sent and is now waiting for acceptance.
INVITE_REQUIRED_FIELDS: Choose a person and at least one role.
ACTION_FAILED: The change could not be completed
ACTION_ERROR: The service didn't apply this change. Check the current status and try again.
ACTION_PERMISSION_ERROR: You don't have permission to make this change.
ACTION_CONFLICT_ERROR: The team changed while you were working. Refresh and review the latest status.
ACTION_VALIDATION_ERROR: Review the selected person, roles, and expiry.
OWNER_DESCRIPTION: One person always holds this responsibility. It can't be delegated.
OPERATORS_DESCRIPTION: Review each operator's access, roles, security setup, and device activity.
INVITATIONS_DESCRIPTION: Review pending invitations and those that are no longer effective.
INVITATION_DESCRIPTION: Review the identity, role outcome, and current invitation status.
ROLES_DESCRIPTION: Review reusable roles and what they allow.
ROLE_CATALOG_DESCRIPTION: Built-in and custom roles currently set up for this deployment.
SIGN_IN_READINESS_DESCRIPTION: Review registration requirements and whether sign-in services are ready.
IDENTITY_PROVIDERS_DESCRIPTION: Installed sign-in services and their setup status.
SESSIONS_DESCRIPTION: Review this account’s verified security methods and active Platform devices.
MFA_DESCRIPTION: See the available security methods and their verification status.
MFA_PAGE_DESCRIPTION: Review the security methods that protect this account's Platform Console access.
MFA_EMPTY: No verified security methods are set up yet.
DEVICE_SESSIONS_DESCRIPTION: See active device sessions without exposing tokens or device fingerprints.
REVOKE_OTHER_SESSIONS_DESCRIPTION: Sessions on every other Platform device will end on their next request. This device and product app sessions stay signed in.
REVOKE_CURRENT_SESSION_DESCRIPTION: The Platform session on {{device}} will end immediately and this Console will return to sign-in. Product app sessions are unchanged.
REVOKE_SESSION_DESCRIPTION: The Platform session on {{device}} will end on its next request. Other Platform and product app sessions are unchanged.
SESSION_REVOKE_CONSEQUENCE: This also ends any security verification linked to the session. It doesn't remove the operator or change roles.
OTHER_SESSIONS_REVOKED: The other device sessions were revoked
SESSION_REVOKE_SUCCESS_DESCRIPTION: The service confirmed the change, and the active device list was refreshed.
SESSION_REVOKE_ERROR: The device session could not be revoked
SESSION_REVOKE_PERMISSION_ERROR: You don't have permission to revoke this session
SESSION_REVOKE_UNCHANGED: The service didn't apply this change. Review the diagnostic code and try again from the current device list.
SESSIONS_EMPTY: No active Platform sessions are recorded.
